story: One cold winter night, Emperor Akbar wondered how cold the river water was. He announced, “If anyone can stand in the cold river all night, I will reward them.” A poor man agreed. He stood in the freezing river all night. The next morning, he went to Akbar for his reward. Akbar asked how he survived. The man said he looked at a distant lamp. Akbar refused to reward him. The poor man felt sad. Birbal heard about this. The next day, Birbal invited Akbar for lunch but kept a pot far above a small fire. Akbar said it would not cook. Birbal replied that just like the lamp could not give warmth, the pot could not cook. Akbar realized his mistake and rewarded the poor man.
